newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.19 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 454.66 points, down from 455.51 on Thursday.
Total volume was 828,046 dinars against 2.51 million dinars over the previous session.
BNDT bank fell 0.87 dinar to 13.85 dinars.
Chemical firm Alkimia was dwon 0.48 dinar to 40.02 dinars. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel eased 0.3 dinar to 8.4. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF edged lower 0.3 dinar to 14.2 dinars.
Investment fund Placement de Tunisie was up 0.33 dinar to 11.38 dinars.
BTEI bank rose 0.14 dinar to 22 dinars. ($1=1.1060 dinar)
